result.instructions: Tools for Dokun, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "List my loyalty-card customers who gave marketing consent."; "Add two stamps to the card with serial ABC123."; "Add a stamp for receipt fis-000123, but only once even if the call is retried.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Dokun data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run dokun_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run dokun_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run dokun_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. dokun_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: dokun_list_customers
tools.title: List loyalty customers
tools.description: List the loyalty-card customers of your Dokun business, newest first. Returns at most 200 records (the 200 most recent sign-ups); there is no pagination. Each record has name, email, created_at and marketing_consent_at (null when marketing consent was not given). The emails are card-holder personal data. Dokun API: GET /api/v1/customers.

tools.name: dokun_add_stamp
tools.title: Add stamps to a card
tools.description: Add stamps to a loyalty card. This changes the card balance and can fire a stamp webhook; it cannot be undone through this tool. serial is the card serial number or the full QR text scanned at the counter (sent as is). delta is the number of stamps to add (default 1). Pass idempotency_key (the receipt number, 1-64 printable ASCII) so a retried call does not add the stamp twice; Dokun keeps the first result for 24 hours. Dokun API: POST /api/v1/stamp.

serial.description: Card serial number, or the full QR text scanned at the counter.

idempotency_key.description: Optional key (for example the receipt number). A repeat with the same key returns the first result.
